body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Auto Com Desk presented an automatic desk and a digital board during KES 2006. If you write down with an electronic pen on the monitor standing on a podium, what you write is exactly seen on a large size digital board, which might be useful in a meeting room in a company, a class room or an auditorium. Mean while, automatic desk saves your space; when you use a computer, a monitor appears upward and it disappears under the desk when it''s not in use; so you can use it as a regular desk with more space to put stuff. The company also demonstrate a desk combined with a book shelf.
